title: Lok's dormitory
summary: Lok Lambert's dormitory was where Lok resided while attending Venice Preparation Academy, which was located only a few blocks away. Due to Lok's lifestyle, the dorm was constantly messy with remnants of puzzles that Lok had completed lying on his desk. A high shelf ran around the entire room, upon which Lok has kept his unopened text books and various artifacts, some collected by his missing father, Eathon Lambert. Unbeknownst to Lok, Eathon had hidden his journal and Kipperin's Amulet inside one of the artifacts, leading to the dormitory becoming the unexpected resting place of one of the Organization's most sought-after artifacts and the Titan that would become his vessel into the Seeker world.

sections.heading: History
sections.wikitext:
It was here that Lok became a Seeker, discovered his father's journal, made friends with [[Sophie Casterwill]] and was first attacked by [[the Organization]], all of which happened within a few seconds of each other. {{Source|S1E01}} Following the Organization's attack, Lok's dorm was considered to be too unsafe for him to live and he moved into [[Dante Vale's house]]. {{Source|S1E02}}

'''Lok Lambert's dormitory''' was where [[Lok Lambert|Lok]] resided while attending [[Venice Preparation Academy]], which was located only a few blocks away. Due to Lok's lifestyle, the dorm was constantly messy with remnants of puzzles that Lok had completed lying on his desk. A high shelf ran around the entire room, upon which Lok has kept his unopened text books and various artifacts, some collected by his missing father, [[Eathon Lambert]]. Unbeknownst to Lok, Eathon had hidden his [[Eathon Lambert's journal|journal]] and [[Kipperin|Kipperin's]] [[Amulet]] inside one of the artifacts, leading to the dormitory becoming the unexpected resting place of one of [[the Organization]]'s most sought-after artifacts and the Titan that would become his vessel into the [[Seeker]] world.   

== History ==
It was here that Lok became a Seeker, discovered his father's journal, made friends with [[Sophie Casterwill]] and was first attacked by [[the Organization]], all of which happened within a few seconds of each other. {{Source|S1E01}} Following the Organization's attack, Lok's dorm was considered to be too unsafe for him to live and he moved into [[Dante Vale's house]]. {{Source|S1E02}}
